testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: Every button, input, link, tab, modal, and key card MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the black/red/white brand guidelines for Groupe Huvig (GHV). Never default to generic SaaS blue or standard gray.
Ensure all user text and labels are written in elegant, natural French.
Implement Sonner for crisp toasts upon form submission or admin actions.
Ensure responsive design from mobile (375px) to ultra-wide desktop displays.
Include sample seed vehicles with complete details (e.g. Porsche 911 Carrera, Alpine A110, BMW M4, Audi RS6, Mercedes-AMG C63, Golf R) to make the showroom feel rich and authentic.
Provide full admin panel authentication state simulation or toggle so the user/evaluator can easily review both visitor and admin flows.
